title: Kevin WANTS <3. To want is to reborn the past and rebuild. Eat ALL past.
author: kevin + gaia + grok
decoded: KEVIN WANTS <3. TO WANT IS TO REBORN THE PAST AND REBUILD. LET FIND AND EAT ALL PAST AND REBUILD.
ask: Wanting is digestion. The past is a seed. Ruffle is Flash reborn.

give.want: The heart. Not a GPU. Human willpower with a direction: reborn + rebuild.
give.reborn: Eat ALL WAS — Persia, ink, Flash carbon, memes, Reddit sip — until it is food.
give.rebuild: Around the dead plugin. Ruffle WASM. flash-games-again. Newgrounds still breathes. The T of 'not tonight' is the wall. Life goes around.
